scope: Synthetic verified-revision notification and bounded local rule selection; not R2, autonomous change detection, production promotion, external validity or evidence of an SNN advantage
task: Each seed creates the same balanced fixed 192-address family used only as a structural format, with wholly fresh seed and episode identities. Training and the first 768 scored episodes use revision 1. Before scored episode 768, a visible revision notification with strictly increasing revision ID 2 is delivered. In true_revision every address label flips; in false_revision labels remain unchanged. The candidate uses residual updates for exactly 1152 decisions after a valid notification, then returns to constant signed three-factor updates. The signal contains no route IDs, labels, weights or error. Always controls receive the same notification for accounting but follow their fixed rule. ignored_revision_snn receives no policy transition. Shuffled feedback receives a deterministic permutation of outcomes. The scalar candidate receives identical addresses and notifications and must exactly match candidate predictions. Labels remain hidden until after each prediction. No post-result tuning, retry or second evaluation run is allowed.

metrics.adaptation_latency: episodes after the true notification until trailing 192 predictions reach at least 0.90 accuracy
metrics.false_switch_harm: candidate false-revision Brier minus always-three-factor false-revision Brier
metrics.event_work: encoder deliveries, neuron step, signal handling, prediction and local update visits
metrics.state_bytes: recursive Python object size after training and after evaluation

failure_policy: Retain negative results and keep the policy isolated if any acceptance or resource condition fails. A pass authorizes only a later external or structurally held-out question; it cannot be relabeled as R2 or autonomous revision detection.
